name: rulereceipt
description: RuleReceipt — a guard that blocks a command breaking a file/branch rule, a Stop hook that won't let a session end on a broken rule, and commands to check what your agent actually did against your rules.

plugins.name: rulereceipt
plugins.description: Guard (PreToolUse) + Stop hook + /rulereceipt:check, :audit, :health, :why. Runs the rulereceipt CLI locally; zero network calls in the guard and checks.
